verdict.rationale: Reducto documents an async parse endpoint: `client.parse.run_job()` calls `POST /parse_async` and returns a job ID immediately. Completion notifications come through Svix webhooks with cryptographic signing, automatic retries with exponential backoff, and a delivery dashboard in Studio. A batch queue with a 20% discount further supports non-blocking pipelines. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented job-status polling endpoint (the returned job ID only implies one), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the async and webhook flow.
